listing.name: Android9k's Python Script Emporium
listing.summary: A collection of python scripts to serve my miscellaneous needs.
listing.aiSummary: Provides Python scripts for modifying faction doctrines and collecting hull styles for hexshield whitelists.

description: Offers utility scripts that modify game files directly, such as adjusting faction doctrines. Includes a script to recursively search for hull styles and compile them into a text file for use with hexshield overlays.
